meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务

copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 装上后,你可以在 Emacs 里直接与 AI 助手对话:打开聊天窗口提问,或把选中的文本、org 内容发送出去。回复会出现在聊天区或 org 文档的子标题位置。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 中用快捷键打开聊天窗口,或通过 org 发送命令把当前内容发出去时,请求走本地 HTTP 桥送到 AI 助手。

say.text: 总结一下这个会议议程。
say.note: 发送 org 议程条目,得到摘要或待办列表。

howto.what_en: After installing, you can talk to the AI assistant directly inside Emacs: ask questions in a chat buffer, or send selected text/org content, and replies appear in the buffer or as a child heading in your org file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open the chat buffer with a keybinding, or use the org-send command to send the current region/heading in Emacs; the request goes through a local HTTP bridge to the assistant.

say_en.text: Why does this function throw an error?
say_en.note: Send in chat buffer; reply appears inline.

say_en.text: Do a code review of the selected region.
say_en.note: Use org-send; reply lands as a child heading.
Send org entry; get summary/action items.
